name: windstream
description: Ask Wind Stream what your team decided. Brings your organization's sessions, decisions and shared context into your coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Wind Stream what your team decided. Brings your organization's sessions, decisions and shared context into your coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Wind Stream is your organization's shared memory. This plugin connects your coding agent to it: ask what the team decided and why, search and read past sessions, and start or continue a Wind Stream conversation without leaving your editor or terminal.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask Wind Stream what the team has decided about this
